title: Mass Gap of Four-Dimensional Lattice Yang--Mills Theory in a Forest Gauge
summary: We fix the gauge of four-dimensional lattice Yang--Mills theory on a field of straight lines that meets every plaquette in exactly one link, so that each free link interacts with twelve others instead of eighteen.
